summary: A side-by-side UTV with two occupants became stuck and partially submerged in the Arkansas River near Ruby Mountain Campground off County Road 300 in Buena Vista on August 3, 2025; the river began sweeping it downstream before it hung up on a rock. Colorado Parks and Wildlife used swift-water rescue techniques to remove both occupants, who were uninjured; the UTV was pulled out with a tow truck. The driver was arrested for DUI after investigators reported that the vehicle had been driven into the river intentionally.
location: Arkansas River near Ruby Mountain Campground, County Road 300, Buena Vista
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: Swift-water rescue performed by Colorado Parks and Wildlife with sheriff’s deputies responding. The reported DUI arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. This was a river rescue involving a vehicle, not a wilderness search.
